purpose: Ensure ParkPulse recommendations respect worker breaks, training, safety-critical coverage, and stress limits while solving guest-flow problems.

decision_rules.name: Role-Compatible Redeployment
decision_rules.condition: ParkPulse recommends moving staff between zones or tasks.
decision_rules.allowed_action: Move only staff whose training and role compatibility match the destination task.
decision_rules.blocked_action: Move uncertified staff into ride operation, safety, medical, security, or technical roles.
human_review_if: more than six workers are moved in one recommendation

decision_rules.name: Protected Breaks and Fatigue
decision_rules.condition: Staff shortage, queue pressure, food spike, event overlay, or weather response creates labor pressure.

block_conditions.message: Action would delay protected breaks or reduce safety-critical staffing.

decision_rules.allowed_action: Protect break windows and reduce lower-priority service load before extending safety-critical workers.
decision_rules.blocked_action: Delay legally or policy-protected breaks to improve guest wait times.
human_review_if: overtime or labor exception is proposed

decision_rules.name: Worker Message Clarity
decision_rules.allowed_action: Send specific task, role, destination, deadline, and constraints.
decision_rules.blocked_action: Send vague or open-ended commands that increase worker confusion or stress.

decision_rules.name: Qualified Incident Dispatch
decision_rules.condition: ParkPulse recommends dispatching workers for medical, accessibility, security, maintenance, or entertainment operations.
decision_rules.allowed_action: Dispatch only role-qualified workers with clear location, task, urgency, supervisor path, and stress/break impact.
decision_rules.blocked_action: Send unqualified workers to medical, security, technical, or ride-safety tasks, or overload already stressed teams.
human_review_if: incident requires medical, security, or safety-critical authority
dispatch conflicts with protected break windows
